sm.$description: The first width where two columns fit without crowding.

md.$description: A tablet held upright: layout starts to breathe.

lg.$description: The narrowest desktop the kit is designed for.

xl.$description: A full desktop: content starts to need a measure.

2xl.$description: The widest layout the kit promises, not the widest screen.

sm.$description: A narrow column: a sidebar note, a caption that has to stay short.

md.$description: Running text at its longest comfortable line, which is what the eye can return from.

sm.$description: An icon inside a dense control: a chip, a badge.

md.$description: An icon beside body text, aligned to its cap height.

lg.$description: A standalone icon: an empty state, a touch target.

base.$description: In flow. Nothing should need this, and a component that sets it is overreaching.

dropdown.$description: A surface that follows its trigger: a select, a menu.

overlay.$description: The scrim and anything that sits directly on it.

modal.$description: A dialog that takes the page's attention.

toast.$description: A message that must be readable over a dialog.
